label: Sparse Gaussian process (SGPR, 500 inducing points)

compute.notes: torch (float64, one thread) for the bound optimisation and the posterior, time.process_time() inside train_gp.py; r1 includes a first attempt (M 1000, 20,000 rows per step) stopped by us at ~140 s because it used 1.4 GB; harness evaluations (<1 s prediction CPU each) not counted

feature_engineering: a scoped, standardised input set: the top-ranked of the 151 inputs by the GBM r0 mean model's gain on the simulated train bank (one-hot architecture / class columns skipped there; 32 in the released rung) + the 14 one-hot architecture / class columns; target z = log(y / E_phys); rows = the train bank under K = 3 tier draws
rule: keep a rung if its frozen sim val skill beats the incumbent's by more than 0.01 AND its dev D16 is not worse than the incumbent's by more than 0.01 (HARNESS.md section 7)
